description: PRD-81: MISSION CLEANUP — Complete the Context & Memory Unification. Finish the half-done PRD-79 and PRD-80 by killing the legacy _build_agent_system_prompt() cache, making ContextService the only prompt path for all 6 agent-facing code paths, adding ComposioSection + PluginsSection, enabling memory for task/recipe paths, and cleaning up ~270 lines of dead prompt-building code.

userStories.title: Create ComposioSection and PluginsSection for ContextService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Composio app context and Plugin context rendered as ContextService sections so that all agent-facing paths get these capabilities instead of only the legacy _build_agent_system_prompt() path.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/modules/context/sections/composio.py with ComposioSection class that has a render() method
ComposioSection queries AgentAppAssignment + ComposioAppCache for the agent's assigned Composio apps
ComposioSection renders a '## Connected Apps' block listing app names, descriptions, and available action hints
If agent has no Composio apps assigned, render() returns empty string
Create orchestrator/modules/context/sections/plugins.py with PluginsSection class that has a render() method
PluginsSection calls PluginContextService.get_assigned_plugins() for the agent
PluginsSection renders tier1 summary (always included) and tier2 content (if under budget) using existing build_tier1_summary() and build_tier2_content_sync()
If agent has no plugins assigned, render() returns empty string
Both sections handle DB errors gracefully (return empty string, log warning)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Port logic from agent_factory.py lines 1222-1278. ComposioSection reads from AgentAppAssignment, ComposioAppCache, ComposioActionCache models. PluginsSection delegates to existing PluginContextService. Both follow the same pattern as existing sections (identity.py, skills.py). Import models from core.models.composio_cache.

userStories.title: Make execute_with_prompt() always use ContextService with context_mode param
userStories.description: As a developer, I need execute_with_prompt() to have a 2-way prompt resolution (explicit > ContextService) instead of the 3-way (explicit > cached > ContextService), with a context_mode parameter for callers to specify which mode to use.
acceptanceCriteria: Add context_mode: Optional[ContextMode] = None parameter to execute_with_prompt() signature
Remove the middle branch that checks getattr(agent_runtime, 'system_prompt', None) — this field no longer exists
The prompt resolution is now: if system_prompt param provided, use it; else call ContextService.build_context(mode=context_mode or ContextMode.TASK_EXECUTION)
When ContextService provides context_result, use context_result.tools instead of calling get_tools_for_agent() separately
When ContextService provides context_result, use context_result.tool_choice if available
When explicit system_prompt is provided, still call get_tools_for_agent() for tool loading (explicit path is responsible for its own tools)
Add a last-resort fallback: if db_agent not found, use minimal identity prompt
Remove the skill_tool_schemas_from_prompt variable and any code that uses it
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the core change. The mode parameter defaults to TASK_EXECUTION but callers like heartbeat can pass HEARTBEAT_AGENT. The explicit system_prompt escape hatch stays for callers that build their own prompts (e.g., execution_manager with hardcoded professional prompt — until Phase 5 cleans it up).
